name: preview-auto-recovery
goal: One managed preview automatically recovers its own failed or unresponsive worker at the same URL while preserving cached history.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: A long-lived supervisor must recover a killed or unresponsive Vite worker at the same owned URL; duplicate starts still reuse it, shutdown must stay stopped, and cached history is preserved.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing preview lifecycle crash case kills the entire launch group and manually starts another preview. It does not cover autonomous worker recovery, event-loop hangs, repeated server errors or intentional shutdown after recovery. Extend that same reusable fixture and registered route-runtime state.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: All three autonomous recovery cases fail on 897b840f; formal red f8ed6458 preserves the unchanged fixture, command and environment.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Fix 6a0c5def retains the ownership listener in Bun and supervises one Node worker with authenticated health probes, serialized shutdown and bounded recovery backoff.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Formal green 3c0af98a at 6a0c5def passes the exact frozen command from red c533e8c6 at e2a95036. All eleven lifecycle cases also pass.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Recovery passes all eleven lifecycle cases at b709affa, and the live frozen worker recovered in 9.92 seconds with its URL and history unchanged. Full verification remains pending: the desktop browser run had 21 failures, one interruption and 42 unrun cases. The missing Evidence coverage assertion also fails in an isolated eee40ecd snapshot from before this task.
